# 🧩 ZMongo Content Pack V3 Demo

## 🎯 What this workflow proves

This workflow demonstrates the **V3 content-pack architecture**:

```text
JSON source
   ↓
Build typed manifest
   ↓
Alias / label edit
   ↓
Save to Local/ZMongo
   ↓
Load normalized pack
   ↓
Typed extractors expose real Comfy types
```

## ✅ Key design rules

- 🏷️ **Aliases** are user-facing output names.
- 🧭 **Source paths** are preserved as metadata only.
- 🔌 Extractor nodes have **fixed official output types**.
- 🖼️ Image fields are returned as real `IMAGE` tensors, not JSON strings.
- 💾 `replace_by_name` prevents stale duplicate packs.

## 🖼️ Included image

The source JSON includes a tiny inline PNG data URI at:

```text
assets.hero_image
```

It is aliased to:

```text
hero_image
```

and extracted through **Get Image V3**.

# 🛠️ How to run

1. Run the whole workflow once.
2. Check **Build report**, **Alias preview**, **Save status**, and **Load summary**.
3. The typed extractor previews should show:

| Alias | Type | Expected value |
|---|---:|---|
| `title` | STRING | V3 Content Pack Demo |
| `description` | STRING | Architecture description |
| `positive_prompt` | STRING | classroom prompt |
| `negative_prompt` | STRING | people/crowd/watermark negative prompt |
| `seed` | INT | 123456789 |
| `rating` | FLOAT | 4.75 |
| `approved` | BOOLEAN | true |
| `source_label` | STRING | inline_json_v3_demo |
| `notes` | STRING | V3 architecture note |
| `hero_image` | IMAGE | tiny inline PNG |

## 🔍 Why this is better than the old dynamic node

The old node tried to let JavaScript mutate sockets after load. This V3 design keeps backend types fixed and reliable.
